bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
head="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
path="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
dirty="$(git status --porcelain | wc -l)"
prsha="0cfc593e1883c2e0a27748d18d8868118354eac1"
if git cat-file -e "$prsha^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
 if git merge-base --is-ancestor "$prsha" HEAD; then merge_status="PR47_ANCESTOR"; else merge_status="PR47_NOT_ANCESTOR"; fi
else merge_status="PR47_OBJECT_NOT_LOCAL"; fi
image="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || printf ABSENT)"
running="$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || printf UNKNOWN)"
paths="$(git status --porcelain | sed -n '1,16p' | sed -E 's#^[ MADRCU?!]{2} ##' | paste -sd ',' -)"
printf 'PR47_RUNTIME_PREDEPLOY=OBSERVED\nHEAD=%s\nDIRTY=%s\nMERGE_STATUS=%s\nGAYBBS_RUNNING=%s\nGAYBBS_IMAGE=%s\nDIRTY_PATHS_FIRST16=%s\n' "$head" "$dirty" "$merge_status" "$running" "$image" "$paths" | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
